title: February check-in: which creative resolutions survived January?
hook: First week of February. Time for an honest check-in.
caption:
First week of February. Time for an honest check-in.

Which of these made it through January on your team?

One change per test.
Ads judged in weeks, not days.
Learnings written down where people can find them.
New ideas, not the same ad in new colours.

If your score is one out of four, you are in good company. Resolutions rarely fail because people stop caring. They fail because they never got a slot in the diary.

So pick one, and give it a recurring half hour every second week.

Tell us your score out of four. Follow @galvor.ai for more.

notes:
Reader: a growth lead one month into the year's plan. The old hook said "31 January" but the slot is 6 Feb, so it now says first week of February. The old caption promised the team would post its own score in the comments; removed, because that is a commitment I cannot make for the team. It also leaned on a 3 Jan resolutions carousel that may have been rewritten, so this post stands alone. Argument: a resolution survives when it has a recurring slot. No numbers from the facts bank.
